votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of February 11, 2025.
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from its February 11, 2025 meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 06 of 2025 adopting Affordable Housing Funding Priorities for Fiscal Year 2025-26.
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution approving the Housing Development Funding Strategy priorities for FY 2025-26, including deeply affordable housing, family housing, wealth building opportunities, expanding opportunities, and neighborhood services and commercial spaces.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent agenda (setting dates of May 20, 2025 and June 3, 2025 to accept public comment and consider approving the CRA budget resolution for Fiscal Year 2025-26).
votes.description: The Board set public hearing dates of May 20 and June 3, 2025 to receive public comment and consider adopting the CRA's final budget for Fiscal Year 2025-26.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property and for attorney-client matters privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session to discuss real property transactions and privileged attorney-client matters in accordance with the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
The Board voted to conclude the closed session and adjourn the meeting.
